This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER
They are heard.
Perused the case diary/challan papers.

This is the first application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.366/2022 registered at Police Station Afjalpur, District Mandsaur (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 354-D, 341, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 5(L)/6,
11(iv)/12 of POCSO Act, 2012.
The applicant is in custody since 23.10.2022.
Allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.
Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix was a consenting party as she has resided with the applicant for a period of 4 days and both of them have also solemnized marriage.
Counsel has also drawn the attention of this Court to the photographs of the applicant and the prosecutrix in happier times.

It is further Pankaj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121756026/
1 submitted that soon after the prosecutrix was recovered, she has been made to give a false complaint against the applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the age of the prosecutrix is disputed.
It is further submitted that the charge sheet has already been filed, applicant is lodged in jail since 23.10.2022 and the final conclusion of trial is likely to take sufficient long time.
Hence, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed and the applicant be released on bail.
Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that no case for grant of bail is made out as the age of the prosecutrix is 16 years and 6 months.

On due consideration of rival submissions, perusal of the case diary as also the photographs filed by the applicant on record, in the considered opinion of this Court, the applicant's application deserves to be allowed.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE Bahar Pankaj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/121756026/
